description: The bar chart illustrates performance gain (in percent) for different LVLM models under two supervision conditions, comparing “Strong Supervision” versus “Weak Supervision.” The category axis is horizontal and lists model names (visible labels include “Claude-3.5-Sonnet” and “Qwen2-72B-…”, with an additional leftmost model label partially cropped), while the value axis is vertical and labeled “Performance Gain (%)” on a linear scale with tick marks at approximately 5-unit intervals (e.g., 5, 10, 15, 20, 25) and extending to roughly 30. Each model has two adjacent bars: a blue bar with diagonal hatching representing Strong Supervision and a solid light-purple bar representing Weak Supervision (as indicated by the legend at the top). For the leftmost (partially cropped) model, the Strong Supervision bar reaches about 25% and the Weak Supervision bar is around 7%. For “Claude-3.5-Sonnet,” the Strong Supervision bar is approximately 15% and the Weak Supervision bar is about 10%. For “Qwen2-72B-…,” the Strong Supervision bar is near 25% and the Weak Supervision bar is around 16%. The bars are grouped by model (side-by-side within each model group), there is no stacking, and there are no visible annotations or special emphasis beyond the color/hatching encoding; the category order appears to follow the left-to-right listing of models rather than an explicitly indicated sorting rule.
